name: Machine Chest Press
grip: Pronated or neutral grip on guided horizontal press handles.
description: Perform a seated horizontal press on a chest machine, pushing handles forward along a guided path while keeping the back supported.
setup: Adjust the seat height so the machine handles align with the mid-to-lower chest.
Sit with back, shoulders, and head resting against the vertical back pad, feet firmly planted on the floor.
Grasp the horizontal press handles with a pronated grip and elbows bent comfortably behind the handles.
instructions: Press the handles forward smoothly along the machine's guide track until arms are fully extended without locking the elbows.
Maintain steady contact between the upper back and back pad throughout the press.
Pause briefly at peak extension under control.
Lower the weight smoothly under control until hands return to chest level, feeling a gentle stretch in the pectorals before initiating the next rep.
cues: Keep back flat against the pad.
Control the return without slamming the stack.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad to assist the press.
Locking the elbows forcefully at full extension.
Letting weight plates slam between repetitions.
